api_key_handling: Colab secret only; never chat, source, notebook output, Git or W&B
controls_required_before_any_paid_call: Dedicated project and API key, not shared with other usage
Provider-side spending limit/prepaid balance within authorization; stop if required minimum deposit exceeds USD 5
Persistent shared local cost ledger across calibration and evaluation, reserving full worst-case request cost before dispatch
Include input, final output and billed reasoning tokens in rate estimate; verify current prices and model identity
Serial requests, bounded output, no SDK automatic retries, no search/tools/caching/storage charges
Ambiguous network failure remains reserved; never assume zero cost or retry blindly
First run only synthetic approved calibration anchors, no final gold sent to judge
No final evaluation until judge calibration and independent confirmation are audited
limit_caveat: Authorization is not a guarantee from a provider. Billing delays, taxes, changed prices and other account usage must be considered; do not enable paid usage until safe controls are verified. No charges have been initiated.
